description: Reference rubric scores (1-5) for round-0 artifacts of the tuned profile, assigned by a human reviewer reading each artifact against the brief's rubric. Used by run_evals.py to measure Critic agreement (MAE and pass/fail verdict agreement). These were authored by the project builder, not an independent EM: replace them with your own EM ratings before relying on the calibration numbers.

items.note: All requirements mapped (FR-04 to the card-network adapter). But several citations are tangential: the web frontend cites the search-centric pattern, the document store cites the serverless pattern; NFR-01 has no source.
NFR-06 usability criterion carried through as 'as stated'; contract-test targets are reasonable but not sourced.
Template risks partly generic (ERP sandbox risk on a non-ERP project); BRD-specific deliverables not themselves sourced.
Uses the standard T1 template for a streaming platform: no PoC phase despite the PB-002 lesson.
Analog-based and well sourced, but estimated at complexity 4 for a complexity-5 architecture.
Clear trade-offs; correctly rejects Flink on familiarity and TD-05 outcome.
Complexity basis 2 vs search-centric architecture complexity 4; no deadline in BRD handled well.
Two of five criteria (search relevance, the core value) unmeasurable; little sourcing for the search criteria.
